## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Every change in behaviour has a test that fails without it.
- [ ] New or changed interface text is in both `src/i18n/en.ts` and `src/i18n/it.ts`.
- [ ] Test files contain synthetic data only (no personal or confidential data, no local paths).
- [ ] A visible change comes with a screenshot or a short recording.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" for a change users will notice.
